messages.subject: conditional sidebarPanel based on tab
parts:
I'd like to have different sidebar Panels be represented based on which tab I use currently. How I could implement it? Now I have

 sidebarPanel(
      
       conditionalPanel(condition="input.tabs=='Heatmap'",
                       helpText("For tab \'Heatmap:\'")
      ),
        conditionalPanel(condition="input.tabs=='About'",
                       helpText("For tab \'About:\'")
      )
     
)
  mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(
      tabPanel("Heatmap", textOutput("k"),plotOutput("heatmap",width = "1000px", height = "1000px"),value=1), 
      tabPanel("About", textOutput("about"),textOutput("about_test"),value=2)
    )
  )

But it doesn't work and I have the following error message

Error in tabsetPanel(tabPanel("Heatmap", textOutput("k"), plotOutput("heatmap",  : 
  tabsetPanel doesn't have an id assigned, but one of its tabPanels has a value. The value won't be sent without an id.

Thank you in advance!
